title: Blade Directives: Conditions, Loops aur $loop
prerequisites: Blade Basics: Echo, Escaping aur Data (m05-l01)

sections.heading: Conditions
sections.body: Blade directives PHP ke control structures ke chhote aur saaf roop hain.
explain: `@if / @elseif / @else / @endif` PHP ke jaise hi kaam karte hain.
`@unless` – condition false ho to chalta hai.
`@isset` – variable defined aur null nahi hai.
`@empty` – variable PHP ke hisaab se 'empty' hai.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Product list loop
sections.body: Products ki list dikhane ke liye `@forelse` sabse kaam ka hai: list khali ho to `@empty` wala hissa dikhta hai. Loop ke andar `$loop` variable milta hai.

code.code:
@forelse ($products as $product)
  • {{ $loop->iteration }}. {{ $product['name'] }} - Rs. {{ $product['price'] }} @if ($loop->last) (aakhri) @endif
    • @empty
  • Koi product nahi mila.
    • @endforelse

explain: `$loop->iteration` – 1 se shuru hone wala number. `$loop->index` – 0 se.
Doosre loops: `@foreach`, `@for`, `@while`. `@continue` aur `@break` se loop control kar sakte ho.

sections.heading: Helper directives: class, checked, error
sections.body: Form aur HTML attributes ke liye chhote helpers hain:

code.code:
$inStock, 'bg-danger' => ! $inStock])> {{ $inStock ? 'In stock' : 'Out of stock' }}
@csrf @method('PUT') @error('name')
{{ $message }}
@enderror active))>

explain: `@class([...])` – condition ke hisaab se CSS classes jodta hai.
`@csrf` – CSRF token. Har POST/PUT/DELETE form mein zaroori.
`@method('PUT')` – HTML form se PUT/PATCH/DELETE spoof karta hai.
`old('name')` – validation fail hone ke baad purani value wapas bharta hai.
`@checked`, `@selected`, `@disabled` – condition true hone par attribute lagate hain.

versionDiff.heading: Directives: Laravel 11, 12 aur 13
versionDiff.intro: Upar ke saare directives teeno versions mein same kaam karte hain.

items.13: Same. Latest docs mein `@session`, `@hasSection`, `@sectionMissing` jaise kuch aur helper directives bhi listed hain.

errors.error: syntax error, unexpected end of file (compiled view mein)
errors.cause: Koi `@if`, `@foreach` ya `@section` band nahi kiya (`@endif`, `@endforeach` missing).
errors.fix: Har opening directive ka matching closing directive likho.

errors.cause: `$loop` sirf `@foreach`/`@forelse` ke andar milta hai, normal PHP `foreach` ya bahar nahi.
errors.fix: `@foreach`/`@forelse` use karo aur `$loop` loop ke andar hi rakho.

debug.body: Compiled output dekhna ho to `storage/framework/views` mein jao. Template mein turant value dekhne ke liye `@dump($var)`.

tasks: Controller se 4 products ka array (name, price) view ko bhejo
`@forelse` se list dikhao aur `@empty` mein message do
Har row mein `$loop->iteration` dikhao aur aakhri row par `(aakhri)` likho
Even/odd rows ko alag CSS class do (`@class` ya `$loop->even`)

quiz.q: List khali ho to message dikhane ke liye kaunsa directive best hai?
quiz.why: `@forelse` ke saath `@empty` khali list ka case handle karta hai.

quiz.q: Form mein PUT request ke liye kya likhte hain?
quiz.why: `@method('PUT')` HTML form se PUT spoof karta hai.

interview.a: `@foreach` jaisa loop jisme `@empty` section hota hai jo collection khali hone par chalta hai.
Loop ke andar iteration, index, first, last, even, odd, count, remaining, depth, parent jaisi properties.
Laravel POST/PUT/DELETE requests par CSRF token check karta hai. Token na ho to 419 error aata hai.
Validation fail hone par form ki pichhli bheji hui value wapas bharta hai.
`@isset` check karta hai ki variable defined hai aur null nahi. `@empty` PHP ke `empty()` ki tarah false-jaisi values (khali array, 0, '') ko pakadta hai.

summary: `@forelse` khali list ka case handle karta hai.
`$loop` se iteration, first, last, even/odd milta hai.
